text: LXVI. 1. Pañc'; ime bhikkhave upādānakkhandhā. Katame pañca? 2. Rūpūpādānakkhandho, vedanūpādānakkhandho, saññūpādānakkhandho, saṅkhārūpādānakkhandho, viññāṇūpādānakkhandho. [page 459] LXVI. 3-LXIX. 3 Satipaṭṭhāna-Vagga. 459 Ime kho bhikkhave pañc'; upādānakkhandhā. 3. Imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ pahānāya . . . ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhāvetabbā ti.
